name: Ardoise
author: Quentin
description: Who is using your machine, in rows that add up to the total: Claude Code sessions with their MCP servers and scratchpads, memory owned by no process (/tmp, zram, kernel), apps and clones. CPU, network, disk and GPU charts. Follows the system language (English, French).

barWidget.description: CPU, RAM and disk in the bar; click for the full breakdown

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the system locale (French for fr_*, otherwise English).

schema.description: Herdr space where “Analyze with Claude” opens its conversation (created if missing). Ignored without Herdr.

schema.label: RAM alert threshold (%)
schema.description: Notify when used RAM reaches this percentage, naming the biggest consumers.
